newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rohm rises in Osaka due to foreigners' buying.
newsitem.headline: Rohm rises in Osaka due to foreigners' buying.

text.p: Shares of electrical machinery maker Rohm Co Ltd were higher on the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) on Tuesday afternoon, mainly due to buying from foreign investors, brokers said.
"Foreigners are continuing small-lot buying purely for investment purposes," a trader at a second-tier securities house said.
Foreigners were buying Rohm shares as they consider that company's shares to be relatively cheap for a blue-chip issue, a trader at another second-tier brokerage said.
Rohm was up 270 yen at 7,440 by 0428 GMT on the OSE.
